title: 8 stencil-op color-probe oracle
purpose: Render an 8-cell 4x2 grid where each cell exercises one of the 8 NV2A stencil ops (KEEP/ZERO/REPLACE/INCRSAT/DECRSAT/INVERT/INCR/DECR). Per cell: clear stencil to 0x80, render an op-pass quad (color=BLACK, stencil func=ALWAYS, op applied to FAIL/ZFAIL/ZPASS, ref=0x40), then a probe quad with stencil func=EQUAL+ref=<expected post-op value>. The probe paints the cell's expected color (one of the 7 saturated RGB cube corners avoiding BLACK) when the post-op stencil matches the spec; if the op was mis-implemented the cell stays BLACK. Pure 0/255 RGB so byte-exact across renderers regardless of display gamma. v1 plan's Tier-2 readback proposal was rejected (Codex finding #7) because Metal's surface-download path skips the stencil aspect; this color-probe redesign keeps the verdict inside the visible drawable. Per the §4.10 spec, the chosen initial stencil 0x80 is intentionally in the no-overflow region for INCRSAT/DECRSAT/INCR/DECR; a separate XBE will exercise the saturation boundary at 0xFF/0x00. **PARTIAL FIX 2026-05-20 late evening (task #14):** Metal's pgraph_mtl_surface_clear hardcoded `desc.stencilAttachment.clearStencil = 0` instead of honoring the decoded stencil clear value from pgraph_get_clear_depth_stencil_value. After the fix the INCRSAT/DECRSAT/INVERT/DECR cells (which previously failed deterministically because their post-op values 0x81/0x7F/0x7F/0x7F never matched a stencil-of-0 starting point) flip from BLACK to expected color. The overall pass rate improves from ~4/8 baseline to a non-deterministic 5-7/8 across runs (signal_match between 50% and 100% across two full rotation runs + three targeted runs). Cells 0 (KEEP), 1 (ZERO), 2 (REPLACE), and 4 (DECRSAT) flap across runs and across frames within a run; no single cell is consistently the failure. The fix is therefore PARTIAL: it removes the deterministic op-value-mismatch failure mode but exposes a separate non-deterministic state-ordering / frame-selection issue. Stays expected_fail on Metal pending root cause of the residual flakiness (open hypotheses: (a) the Metal clear's depth+stencil aspects are not separately gated by NV097_CLEAR_SURFACE_Z vs _STENCIL bits per Codex 2026-05-20 review finding #1; (b) per-cell clear-rect scissor is ignored so partial per-cell stencil writes survive across cells; (c) pbkit or upstream emits a Z-only clear between cells that resets stencil unintentionally; (d) the screenshot-frame selector picks frames before the steady state is reached). GL and real-Xbox cells are expected to PASS unchanged. When the residual Metal investigation lands, remove `metal` from expected_fail_renderers.
